nodes.meaning: The private CyberAlchemy-v2 product whose systems should increase human capability without transferring avoidable complexity to the user.
The candidate Agent Reasoning Engine capability that provides the bounded reasoning and context-management parent boundary.
Produce context-appropriate perspectives over source-bound knowledge while preserving material limits and reducing avoidable cognitive effort.
The capability-local business meaning for contextual framings, distilled knowledge, bounded analogies, fit assessment, and expiry.
The consumer can reach useful understanding with less avoidable cognitive effort without losing load-bearing qualifications.
A request naming the consumer, objective, decision or action horizon, context, desired depth, constraints, and protected effects.
The frozen source-bound knowledge, provenance, uncertainty, contradictions, exclusions, and source epoch eligible for framing.
A compact representation that preserves the knowledge needed for the named objective and makes omitted detail explicit.
An explicitly partial structural mapping from a familiar source domain to the target knowledge, including matches, mismatches, and a break condition.
One purpose-selected perspective containing distilled knowledge, an optional bounded analogy, progressive depth, source references, limitations, and expiry conditions.
A typed assessment of consumer fit, objective fit, preserved constraints, analogy risk, cognitive load, uncertainty, and expiry.
Freeze the request and knowledge substrate, identify invariant meaning, propose perspectives, bound analogies, assess fit, and return candidates with limitations.
Compression must not remove constraints, uncertainty, contradictions, provenance, or authority boundaries material to the named objective.
Every analogy must declare what maps, what does not map, and when reliance on the analogy becomes unsafe.
A framing is valid only for its named consumer, objective, context, source epoch, and expiry condition.
The consumer may move from a compact framing to its supporting detail without changing the underlying claim or hiding residue.
A framing, analogy, fit assessment, or user preference cannot grant authority or permit an effect.
